name: San Francisco
living: the string of lights along the bridge cables twinkles and chases slowly
the fog banks roll slowly between the towers and over the hills (fog layer drift)
the kayaks bob gently on the bay beyond the right-field wall
the bay water glitters with the reflected bridge lights
the orange pennants on top of the scoreboard flutter
the scoreboard clock's hands creep forward; the ball on the board pulses
tower windows flicker; the pointed tower's tip light blinks
stars twinkle faintly in the violet sky
crowd shimmer in the stands, with camera flashes and a cheer pulse on a home run
note: fences in m at spray -45 (lf) / 0 (cf) / +45 (rf) deg, optional lcf / rcf at -22.5 / +22.5; wallHeight = the painted wall's height (m) at the fence (qa.py --wall-height); wallProfile (optional) = spray ranges where the painted wall is much taller/shorter; living = suggested living-painting details for this park (masks, sprites, shaders)
